content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Existing platforms like Gumroad charge exorbitant fees up to 10% on each sale, which can significantly cut into your profits. In contrast, NOWPayments only takes a 0.5% fee. This difference means that if you're selling a $97 product and make 100 sales a month, you retain an additional $921. This infrastructure allows you to build a store that isn’t reliant on these restrictive platforms, empowering you to operate freely with greater profitability.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need a few essential components. Start with a free hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets will serve as your order storage, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 is ideal for file delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. With these tools, you’re ready to build a system that functions independently of conventional payment processors.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your chosen hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Once that’s active, implement your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This will handle your transactional processes. Next, set up your order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets to keep track of customer purchases. For file delivery, ensure your files are stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to automate payment processing and verification. This pipeline ensures that every transaction is seamless and efficient.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, keeping more profit in your pocket.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is established, it's time to go live. First, conduct a series of tests to ensure everything functions correctly. With your store ready, share the URL with your audience. Encourage customers to make their first purchases using crypto through NOWPayments. Monitor the transactions closely, ensuring that orders are processed automatically and files delivered as promised. This live operation allows you to refine your process based on real user interactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your first transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Start by increasing your product offerings, which can attract a wider audience. Utilize tools from the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to add more blueprints and templates to your store without incurring additional costs. Engage with your customers for feedback to improve the user experience. This proactive approach will help you grow your business sustainably and effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by setting up your own digital store using a combination of free hosting and processing tools. Use GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, which eliminates the need for traditional payment platforms.
Build your digital store without the constraints of traditional platforms.

Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I process payments without Stripe?
You can use NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, which requires no KYC and charges only a 0.5% fee per transaction. This allows you to handle payments without relying on traditional platforms.
What if I want to sell multiple products?
Your infrastructure can easily scale. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to add more products and templates. This resource provides everything you need to expand your offerings quickly.
How do I deliver digital products after purchase?
Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure file delivery. Once payment is processed via NOWPayments, your automated system will handle file access for customers seamlessly.
Can I accept multiple cryptocurrencies?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse audience. This flexibility enhances your sales potential.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
You receive 30 days of support when you deploy your stack. This ensures that you can resolve any issues quickly and effectively as you start selling digital products.
Control your infrastructure and eliminate ongoing subscription fees.
